title: Distillation of Foundation Models for Time-dependent PDEs
abstract: arXiv:2608.11937v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation models for time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs) are trained on large and diverse collections of physical systems and can generalize effectively to new downstream tasks. After fine-tuning on only a few trajectories from a target domain, they can achieve strong accuracy in low-data regimes. However, these models are typically large and computationally intensive, limiting their usefulness as fast surrogates for numerical solvers. We propose Teacher Rollout Extension (TREX), a knowledge distillation framework that transfers the predictive capability of a pretrained foundation model into a compact and efficient student. Starting from a fine-tuned teacher, TREX augments limited downstream data by generating long synthetic trajectories through teacher rollouts, optionally with periodic noise injection. This procedure samples from the teacher-induced rollout distribution without requiring explicit knowledge of the init

translated_title: 针对时间依赖偏微分方程的基础模型蒸馏
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11937v1 公告类型：新 摘要：针对时间依赖偏微分方程（PDEs）的基础模型在大规模和多样化的物理系统集合上进行训练，并能有效泛化到新的下游任务。在仅对目标域的少数轨迹进行微调后，它们能在低数据场景下实现高精度。然而，这些模型通常规模庞大且计算密集，限制了它们作为数值求解器快速替代品的实用性。我们提出了教师滚动扩展（TREX），这是一种知识蒸馏框架，能将预训练基础模型的预测能力转移到一个紧凑高效的模型中。从微调后的教师模型开始，TREX通过教师滚动生成长合成轨迹来扩充有限的下游数据，可选地加入周期性噪声注入。该过程从教师诱导的滚动分布中采样，无需显式初始化知识。
tldr: 本文提出TREX框架，通过教师滚动生成合成轨迹来蒸馏大型基础模型为紧凑模型，在低数据场景下保持高精度并提升计算效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TREX, a distillation framework that transfers large foundation models into compact students via teacher rollout-generated synthetic trajectories, maintaining accuracy in low-data regimes while improving computational efficiency.
